package.description: A fast, native, read-only Markdown viewer.

en-US.description: A fast, native, read-only Markdown viewer.
en-US.longDescription:
FastMarkdownViewer opens Markdown documents in a native desktop window with tabs,
an outline, Find, syntax highlighting, tables, equations, and offline Mermaid diagrams.
It supports multilingual text, themes, and saved settings and sessions.
en-US.name: FastMarkdownViewer
